name: editReligion
description: This tool updates an existing Religion record in EIM/Religion.aspx. It locates the record using either an exact religion code or a partial/complete religion name, opens the matching row via the same ASP.NET __doPostBack event used by the UI edit icon, enters edit mode, updates the Religion name, and saves the record. After saving, it performs a follow-up search to confirm the record reflects the new name, ensuring the transformer does not return a false “success” when the server responds with HTTP 200 but does not persist the change.
